name: Constellation Explorer
shortDescription: An interactive night-sky canvas app featuring 10 iconic constellations. Tap or click any constellation to highlight its star pattern and reveal its mythology, notable stars, and astronomical lore.

generation.notes: Original concept: Educational constellation explorer filling the gap in the gallery (no Education apps existed). Features a full-canvas starfield with 10 major constellations (Orion, Ursa Major, Ursa Minor, Cassiopeia, Leo, Scorpius, Cygnus, Canis Major, Gemini, Lyra). Click/tap hit detection selects nearest constellation; animated glow, info panel with mythology and star data, show/hide lines and labels controls, shooting star animation, twinkling background stars. Token counts are estimates.
